title: Person
description: An individual who is relevant to one or more investigations. Person records hold IDENTITY and DISAMBIGUATION data only (names, dates, uncontested public roles). Any contestable assertion about a person — employment, participation, knowledge, responsibility — must be expressed as a Claim with evidence and an assessment, never stored as a profile attribute. Recording a person is a factual record of relevance, not an accusation.

id.description: Stable entity identifier in format boe:person:<ulid>. Constant across versions.

display_name.description: The name by which this person is referred to in the investigation. May be a pseudonym for protected sources.

full_name.description: Full legal name, if known and appropriate to record.

is_pseudonymous.description: True if display_name is a pseudonym for a confidential source.

roles.description: Roles this person held relevant to the investigation (e.g., 'Director of the FBI', 'Witness', 'Source').

organisations.description: Organisation entity IDs this person was affiliated with.

relevance.description: Why this person is relevant to the investigation(s) they appear in.

nationality.description: Nationality or citizenship relevant to the investigation.
